headline: JPL has today finalised the Issue Price at Rs. 1,119 per Equity Share and has also filed Prospectus dated October 24, 2026 with the Registrar of Companies, Gujarat at Ahmedabad.
so_what: JPL finalized IPO issue price at ₹1,119 per equity share.
